title: Conductor-cognition support cluster
description: The conductor's INWARD cognitive vocabulary over swarm-owned memory: recognition weighting, suiting (context-spacesuit composition), the recall verbs (remembering/wondering/imagining/ruminating), exploring (outward sensing via an injected reader), capturing (IO→claim), and projecting (claims↔SHP packet). Per docs/GENEALOGY.md the memory and its recall are the swarm's; the carrier (claude-code-harness) only wires these to MCP tools and hooks. Admitted under hacking/ as the conductor's conscious vocabulary lifted into the substrate (recall-as-recall coincidence), not a fresh derivation. A support cluster, not a single morphism: its closure rules are the individual exports.

exports.description: The named verbs this cluster provides.
